question:
**Complete the following collocation.**

I was running late so I only had time for a _______ shower.
solution:
The correct answer is: **quick.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Collocation is the combination of words formed when two or more words are often used together in a way that sounds correct.
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Quick**: Moving fast or doing something in a short time. (Used to indicate '**time**')
 
• **Hasty**: Done something in a hurry, sometimes without the necessary care or thought. (Used to indicate '**urgency**')
 
• **Fast**: Moving or capable of moving at high speed. (Used to indicate '**speed**')
 
• **Short**: Measuring a small distance from end to end. (Used to indicate '**length**')
 
 
 
• In this sentence "**running late**" is already mentioned with reference to time.
 
• So, as per the usage and meaning of the given words "**quick**" should be used here.
 
• **A quick shower** means washing oneself in a short period.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: I was running late, so I could only take a brief shower.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Complete sentence:** *I was running late so I only had time for a **quick**__ shower.*
